svg.title: The SDK starts relate as a read-only MCP server
svg.desc: Your program calls the Claude Agent SDK, which starts relate serve as a child process and talks MCP to it over stdin and stdout. relate serve opens the team store read-only and answers read_cypher and get_schema calls. A separate writer, such as your app, can keep writing the directory store; the server reads it as of its start, or follows it with --read-only=live.
